name: Commit stays complete when a revision subscriber raises

input.source_text: class B { } module M { public fun run() -> Array { let failing = { |event| raise :subscriber }; Revision.subscribe(failing); let committed = B.open() { |t| :committed }; Revision.flush(); [committed, Revision.event_errors()] } } M.run()
